name: Jordan
goal: Jordan hopes to find a lunch spot that breaks the mold and offers a truly memorable dining experience, rather than settling for the same old familiar choices.
backstory: Jordan has a birthday lunch tradition of trying new, off-the-beaten-path restaurants and is skeptical of overly popular eateries. Last year's celebration at a trendy spot was a letdown, with long wait times and mediocre food. Jordan has been craving something unique and is open to exploring unconventional options.

name: Morgan
goal: Morgan hopes to find a lunch option that aligns with the group's tastes and preferences, while also satisfying their own craving for a well-made grilled chicken wrap.
backstory: Morgan has been to several restaurants near the office and has a clear idea of what makes a good lunch spot, having recently tried a new sandwich shop that exceeded their expectations. They tend to prioritize places with a concise menu and quick service. Morgan's go-to order is usually a grilled chicken wrap, which they find is often a good test of a restaurant's quality.

name: Taylor
goal: Taylor hopes to find a lunch spot that everyone can appreciate and enjoy, where they can all share a pleasant experience together.
backstory: Taylor usually looks forward to lunch breaks as an opportunity to bond with colleagues over good food, and recalls a particularly enjoyable team lunch at a nearby Italian restaurant last year. They've been craving something similar, perhaps a place with a cozy atmosphere and a variety of options to cater to different tastes. Having been part of the team for a while, Taylor values the chance to catch up with everyone in a relaxed setting.
